title: Temporarily disable `@astrojs/renderer-vue`
body:
## Changes

Snowpack is unable to install `@vue/server-renderer`, which is included in our `externals` but for some reason Snowpack is still attempting to build it. After going down the rabbit hole, the best solution seems to be to **temporarily** disable `@astrojs/renderer-vue` so that folks can play with `astro/next` until I can dig into this more.

## Testing

Tests are failing, but that is expected as we **temporarily** do not support Vue components.

## Docs

N/A
